search_limit.source: the graph's search op admits a limit of 1..100 passages (graph/src/store/search.av)

choice_letters.source: the shared service's choose op letters 2..26 options (graph/extract/cascade.py)

answer_tokens.source: the shared service's generate op caps an answer at 4096 tokens when none is asked (graph/extract/cascade.py)

question_years.source: years either side of the asking year offered for a question's time; a starting point to fit against labelled questions, not fitted

rank_rule.source: the joint log-probability of the answer and the turn's end is one distribution over whole answers; per-token mean is the alternative, compared on the planner bench (graph/planner/bench) and recorded in its results

beam_width.source: candidates kept per round; fitted on dev planner mode: (2 wide, 2 flips, 1 round) passed the same 8 of 36 as the plain walk at 48 s mean planning time, so the declared value is the plain walk (graph/acceptance/results/score-planner-20261022T085649.json)

beam_flips.source: least-sure decisions flipped per kept candidate; fitted with beam_width

beam_rounds.source: rounds of flips; fitted with beam_width

beam_score.source: candidates rank by the joint log-probability of their picks; the per-decision mean is the alternative, compared on dev

kind_shortlist.source: kinds offered to the kind choice, by embedding similarity of the question to each model's declared text; null offers all; fitted on dev when the embed op is served

rank_use.source: measured on the dev planner bench: whole-answer ranking 71/109 decisions against 84/103 for lettered choices, and on the kind choice alone 21/34 for ranking (sum) and for lettered heats, 15/34 with a null-prompt prior subtracted (graph/planner/bench/results)

preview.source: options show what the graph holds at the walk's current point (sight.py); measured against none on the planner bench (graph/planner/bench/results)

preview_rows.source: sample rows shown per option; not fitted; to be swept over {0,1,2,3,5} on graph-gym's frozen eval split; shrunk per decision until the prompt fits the model's declared context budget (structured.fitted)

beam_k.source: partial plans kept per decision; k=1 is the greedy walk; measured at 1 and 3 on the dev planner bench (graph/planner/bench), not fitted; to be fitted on graph-gym's frozen eval split with the contrast step

beam_prune.source: a partial plan whose pattern binds no row in the graph is dropped, and a walk whose answer is empty is never chosen (graph/planner/beam.py)

preview_values.source: a property option shows sample values of that property; measured on the dev planner bench: with samples 8/17 property and 10/19 more-property decisions against 11/17 and 13/19 without (graph/planner/bench/results)

contrast.source: surviving plans are grouped by the answer they return and, when two or more groups remain, the model chooses one or declines all (contrast.py); measured against taking the best-scoring plan on the planner bench (graph/planner/bench/results)
